questions.question: PromQL'da error rate foizini qanday hisoblaysiz?
Kubernetes'da container CPU foizini (limit'ga nisbatan) PromQL bilan qanday hisoblaysiz?
PromQL vector matching (`on()`, `ignoring()`, `group_left()`, `group_right()`) nima?
questions.explanation: Arifmetik operatsiyalarda ikki vektor label'larini moslash:

questions.question: OTel Collector'da xatolarni ushlash uchun tail-based sampling qanday sozlanadi?
OTel TraceIdRatioBased sampler nima?
questions.explanation: SDK darajasidagi head-based sampler: Trace ID hash'i bo'yicha deterministik foizni saqlaydi (ParentBased bilan birga — bir trace bo'ylab izchil qaror).

questions.question: Tempo'da trace-to-logs va logs-to-trace korrelyatsiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Grafana'da Tempo va Loki data source'larini traceId maydoni bo'yicha bog'lash (derived fields) — trace va log orasida bir bosishda ikki tomonlama o'tish.

questions.question: Thanos Querier va Thanos Store Gateway farqi.
questions.explanation: Querier: stateless so'rov engine — jonli sidecar'lar va Store Gateway'lar bo'ylab PromQL, HA dublikatlarini dedup qiladi.

questions.question: Thanos Compactor nima?
questions.explanation: S3'dagi block'larga downsampling (5 daqiqa va 1 soat rezolyutsiya), compaction va retention qo'llaydigan singleton servis.

questions.question: Mimir arxitekturasi (distributor, ingester, querier, compactor) qanday?
questions.explanation: Distributor: stateless — sample'larni validatsiya qilib hash bo'yicha ingester'larga taqsimlaydi.
